mechanism_narrative: A higher level of industrial production (INDPRO) above its 2017 baseline (100) indicates robust manufacturing output and corporate capacity utilization, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is always active as INDPRO consistently exceeds 100.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where INDPRO is above 100, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate (UNRATE) above 4.5% signals deteriorating labor market conditions and reduced consumer spending power, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (UNRATE > 4.5%), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous increase in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates strong consumer demand and economic momentum, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days through improved corporate earnings visibility.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances where both HOUST and RSAFS are above their 12-month moving averages, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In high inflation regimes (CPIAUCSL > 207.0), persistent price pressures force central banks to maintain restrictive monetary policy, reducing equity valuations and driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 207.0), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A higher level of real GDP (GDPC1) above its quarterly trend indicates sustained economic expansion and corporate revenue growth, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days. The signal is always active as GDP growth is positive in most periods.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5-day returns in > 60% of instances where GDPC1 is above its 4-quarter moving average, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) above 207.0 indicates accelerating inflation, prompting aggressive monetary tightening that depresses equity valuations and drives negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 207.0), or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of strong employment growth (PAYEMS) and low unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a tight labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate profit margins, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through elevated earnings expectations.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in > 60% of instances where PAYEMS is above its 12-month growth rate and UNRATE is below 4.0%, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.

mechanism_narrative: In post-shock recovery regimes (e.g., following a market correction), rising housing starts (HOUST) signal renewed consumer confidence and economic activity, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days as corporate earnings rebound.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60-day returns in > 60% of instances during post-shock recovery periods with rising HOUST, or the Rank IC over 3-year rolling windows is below 0.03.
